hooks.command: jq -e '(.tool_input.file_path // "") as $p | ($p | test("(^|/)ent/")) and (($p | test("(^|/)ent/schema/")) | not) and (($p | test("(^|/)ent/generate\\.go$")) | not)' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Generated by ent - edit ent/schema then run make schema (or make schema-advance), do not hand-edit generated ent code"}}' && exit 1 || exit 0

jq -e '(.tool_input.file_path // "") | test("(^|/)cmd/docs/")' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Generated by swag - edit swagger annotations on the controller then run make swagger, do not hand-edit cmd/docs"}}' && exit 1 || exit 0

jq -e '(.tool_input.file_path // "") | test("(^|/)mocks/")' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Generated by mockery - update the interface then run make mocks, do not hand-edit files under mocks"}}' && exit 1 || exit 0

jq -e '(.tool_input.file_path // "") | test("(^|/)go\\.sum$")' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"go.sum is derived from go.mod - run go mod tidy or go get instead of hand-editing"}}' && exit 1 || exit 0

jq -e '(.tool_input.file_path // "") | test("(^|/)(\\.env(\\..+)?|secret\\.env)$")' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Credential and config files are not edited by the agent - print the change for a human to apply directly"}}' && exit 1 || exit 0

jq -e '(.tool_input.file_path // "") | test("(^|/)migrations/(20230818233139_add_table_for_example\\.go|20230818233748_insert_example_with_go\\.go|20230818234958_insert_example_with_sql\\.sql|20260630120001_add_table_for_roles\\.go|20260630120002_add_table_for_users\\.go|20260630120003_add_table_for_role_users\\.go|20260630120004_add_table_for_system_parameters\\.go|20260630120005_seed_roles_and_admin_user\\.go)$")' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"This migration file is already applied history - goose migrations are immutable, create a new migration with make migration-create instead of editing this one"}}' && exit 1 || exit 0

jq -e '(.tool_input.file_path // "") | test("(^|/)coverage\\.(html|out)$")' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Coverage report is generated by make test - do not hand-edit"}}' && exit 1 || exit 0

jq -e '(.tool_input.command // "") | test("git\\s+(commit|push|tag|reset|rebase|branch\\s+-[dD]|clean\\s+-f)")' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Git write operations are not permitted for the agent - print the git command for the human to run instead"}}' && exit 1 || exit 0

jq -e '(.tool_input.command // "") | test("terraform\\s+(apply|destroy)|kubectl\\s+delete|gcloud\\s+.*\\s(delete|destroy)")' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Infrastructure mutation commands are not permitted for the agent - this needs explicit human execution"}}' && exit 1 || exit 0

jq -e '(.tool_input.command // "") | test("mysql\\s+.*-e\\s|psql\\s+.*-c\\s|\\bDROP\\s+TABLE\\b|\\bTRUNCATE\\b"; "i")' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Direct database execution is not permitted for the agent - use a goose migration under migrations instead"}}' && exit 1 || exit 0
